title: Digital Twins
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Ask whether a claimed digital twin has an update loop, which is the definition.
Treat patient specific modelling as valuable and as a different thing from a twin.
Expect material properties to be the limiting gap rather than geometry or computation.
Expect material properties to be assumed from a population, and ask whether they were.
Treat narrow single tissue twins as the plausible version and general ones as marketing.
There is no agreed standard for what a clinical digital twin must demonstrate, which is why the term is doing work the evidence is not.
Ask for the update loop and for prospective individual validation before accepting the term.
State that no agreed standard exists for what a clinical digital twin must demonstrate.

Weigh the patient's age and physiology, comorbidities, knee demand, psychological state and their own ideas, concerns and expectations before showing them a model of their own knee, because a picture of your own joint failing is a powerful thing to be given.
- No agreed standard exists for what a clinical digital twin must demonstrate.
